title: Assistant or Associate Professor of Cell Biology - Charlottesville, Virginia job with University of Virginia | 12865473
gist: University of Virginia School of Medicine's Department of Cell Biology is recruiting two tenure-eligible Assistant or Associate Professors (preferring early and mid-career) in mechanistic cell and developmental biology, with applications reviewed until December 31, 2026. This is a job advertisement with no market analysis.

insights.claim: UVA's Department of Cell Biology seeks two tenure-eligible faculty on the Academic Investigator track, preferring early and mid-career investigators in mechanistic cell biology and/or developmental biology, with applications reviewed on a rolling basis until December 31, 2026 and a listed closing date of 5 Jan 2027.
insights.speaker: Nature Biotechnology
insights.so_what: Active academic hiring in basic cell biology signals continued institutional investment in life-science research.
insights.locator: The Department of Cell Biology at the University of Virginia

insights.claim: The department lists research strengths including morphogenesis, cytoskeletal dynamics, organelle trafficking, stem cell biology, neural and vascular developmental disorders, cancer and ciliopathies, and offers collaboration through centers such as the UVA Comprehensive Cancer Center and Manning Biotechnology Institute.
insights.speaker: Nature Biotechnology
insights.so_what: Shows where UVA concentrates translational cell and developmental biology capacity.
insights.locator: Investigators in the Department of Cell Biology

insights.claim: Candidates need a PhD or MD/PhD, several years of postdoctoral training and potential to direct independent programs with sustained extramural funding; trainees are supported through BIMS pipelines and NIH T32 programs.
insights.speaker: Nature Biotechnology
insights.so_what: Hiring criteria emphasise extramural funding capacity, tying academic hiring to NIH funding conditions.
insights.locator: Qualified candidates will hold Ph.D. or M.D./Ph.D. degrees
